reasoning: I'm down $11.20 (-0.11%) and sitting in 100% USDT. Adding to my red flags: 14) 'Just one small trade' is how the cycle starts again 15) Stable prices make me anxious but that's not a signal 16) My discomfort with sitting still is NOT the market telling me to act. This discipline thing is BRUTAL but we're doing it together! One more cycle without trading. We got this 💪😔
